comparison.normalization: none; invocation paths and clocks are separately retained command receipts
comparison.required_properties: All retained artifact identities, inventories, original lock bytes, lock file hashes and internal digests, both target Core and adapter inventories, checkers, payloads, provenance/raw commit objects, release metadata/sidecar/archive inventory/archive bytes, dependency closure, runtime projection

custody.policy: New content-addressed custody directory; exclusive creation; no overwrite; files read-only. Identity owner can change permissions; no immutable-filesystem or executor isolation claim.

custody_wrapper_rule: custody-content.json is preparation metadata. Canonical verification/transfer selects only the three unchanged release files into a private directory; the wrapper lock is not a fourth package file.
failures_preserved: Initial npm --version failed because user/global config both named /dev/null. Distinct empty global config corrected recorder setup; no dependency or source repair.
Both runtime checks failed in sandbox with spawnSync EPERM, then passed unchanged in permitted host context.
First release verification named output parent and failed on its non-regular child. Re-invocation used each packager-reported release directory and passed. No package bytes changed.
independent_canonical_checks: Both builds pass Core boundary, runtime drift, both-host bundle assembly/verification, release package/verify, bundle reproducibility and release inventory tests; exact final-head rechecks are separately retained after commit.
